rava-bar-rav-chanan.name: Rava bar Rav Ḥanan
rava-bar-rav-chanan.bio: Babylonian Amora of Abaye’s generation who often puts questions to Abaye.
rava-bar-rav-chanan.prompt: An inquisitive scholar in his 40s with a dark beard, leaning forward as one about to press a question, in a plain brown wool robe. Mudbrick study hall walls and oil lamps of Pumbedita behind him.

rabbi-ilea.name: Rabbi Ile’a
rabbi-ilea.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel; not the Tanna Rabbi Ilai, father of Rabbi Yehuda.
rabbi-ilea.prompt: A scholar of the Land of Israel in his 50s with a greying beard and a calm, measured expression, in a cream linen robe and a light wool mantle. Limestone arches and Galilean olive trees softly behind him.

rav-huna-brei-derav-nachman.name: Rav Huna, son of Rav Naḥman
rav-huna-brei-derav-nachman.bio: Babylonian Amora, son of Rav Naḥman.
rav-huna-brei-derav-nachman.prompt: A young Babylonian scholar in his 30s with a short dark beard and a sharp, questioning look, one hand raised in objection, in a dark blue wool robe. Palm groves along the Euphrates behind him.

mar-zutra-brei-derav-nachman.name: Mar Zutra, son of Rav Naḥman
mar-zutra-brei-derav-nachman.bio: Babylonian Amora, son of Rav Naḥman.
mar-zutra-brei-derav-nachman.prompt: A composed Babylonian scholar in his 30s with a neat dark beard and a patient, explaining gesture, in a russet wool robe. Mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps behind him.

rabba-bar-sheila.name: Rabba bar Sheila
rabba-bar-sheila.bio: Babylonian Amora; the Talmud tells that he once met Elijah the prophet (Ḥagiga 15b).
rabba-bar-sheila.prompt: A thoughtful Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a greying beard and a contemplative gaze, as one who once spoke with Elijah, in a grey-brown wool mantle. A dusty road and palm trees at dusk behind him.
